name: Count runs in a file to see how long an agent workspace lives
description: An AI agent keeps a run counter in a file in its workspace. Run it twice in the editor and the count stays at 1, because every test run gets a fresh workspace; deploy it and the count grows with each run, because a deployed workflow keeps its workspace.
shortDescription: A run counter in a file shows that deployed workflows keep their agent workspace.
keyFeatures: File System Tools reading and writing one file
Fresh workspace per editor test run
Workspace kept between runs of a deployed workflow
prerequisites: Server setting bytechef.ai.agent-utils.file-system.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED), which turns on the File System, Glob, Grep and List Directory tools
A project deployment, to see the count grow across runs
idealFor: Administrators of self-hosted ByteChef who want to check how the Agent Utils file and shell tools behave before they let agent builders use them.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Run in the workflow editor.
Run the checks: the AI Agent reads run-count.txt, adds one and writes it back.
Log the report: the Logger step prints the agent's PASS/FAIL table to the execution log.
